sample.ours: K. S. DIGVlJAY SINHJI v. S. N. NANJISAVDAS & ORS. August 26, 1965 [K. SUBBA RAO, C.J., M. H. BEG, J. C. SHAH, S. M. SIKRI, R. S. BACHAWAT AND K. S. HEGDE, JJ.] Saurashtra Land Reforms Act (25 of 1951), ss. 18, 19, 20(2) and 50(2)-Appellant's grant of land to himself subject to the condition that he would not evict the tenants-Whether the appellant could apply under s. 19 for allotment of land for personal cultivation and thereby seek to evict the tenants. The appellant obtained a grant of certain lands from the ruler of the Virpur State. The grant was recorded in the "Hak Patrak" of the Virpur State. The administration of the Virpur State was assumed by the United State of Saurashtra. The grant was questioned by the Saurashtra Government.
